note: 每个模块对应 Scher bundle patch 里的一行 Loader 行；选择性安装 = 用 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 给未选中的行加 disabled: true。scripts/select-modules.mjs 会读取本清单、提示相互依赖，并维护 profile 里的选中块。

title.zh: 配色方案 + 完成时闪烁任务栏

summary.zh: 十套 Markdown 阅读配色，控制整窗背景、正文排版与侧栏主区；消息输入区域可以单独自定义文字颜色与背景色；Host 半边在会话完成一轮、或需要你审批/回答提问而窗口不在前台时闪烁 Windows 任务栏图标。
summary.en: Ten reading palettes for the whole window and rendered Markdown, custom text/background colours for the message input; the Host half flashes the Windows taskbar when a Session finishes a turn or needs the user (approval / structured question) while the window is out of focus.

notes.zh: 任务栏闪烁仅 Windows、依赖系统 PowerShell；配色与闪烁可以分别关（闪烁在 config.taskbarFlash 下，enabled: false 即可关闭）。本地修复：异常会话打开后清除红色，历史错误重挂载不会重复标红。 另外把会话状态配色发布成 --dcs-status-* CSS 变量，供待办等面板联动。
notes.en: The taskbar flash is Windows-only and uses the system PowerShell; palettes and the flash switch independently (config.taskbarFlash.enabled). Local fix: opening an error session clears its red tint and a remounted historical error does not re-raise it. It also publishes the session-status palette as --dcs-status-* CSS variables so sibling panels can follow it.

summary.zh: 侧栏工作区按最近活跃排序、拖动/图钉置顶、历史折叠、归档与回收站、Token 统计、移动工作区、交接到新会话、会话内容搜索；**本地定制**：「历史」页直接读取会话日志列出全部真人提问，进入时停在最近提问，点击气泡跳回原消息。
summary.en: Sidebar workspace recency ordering, pinning, folding, archive/trash, token stats, move/handoff, and content search; locally adds a History view that reads the durable session log for every human prompt, lands on the most recent one, and jumps back to its turn.

notes.zh: 会接管左侧工作区会话栏；与 dsh-better-sidebar（右侧栏）互不冲突。 历史 Tab 读完整会话日志（含压缩前提问）；搜索页打开时自动聚焦输入框。
notes.en: Owns the left workspace/session column; independent of the right sidebar. History reads the full session log (including pre-compaction prompts); opening search focuses the input.

summary.zh: 右侧栏：文件树、编辑器、Git 变更、任务、侧边对话，按会话隔离；并向其它插件提供注册侧栏标签页的服务。
summary.en: Right sidebar with file tree, editor, Git changes, tasks and side chat, isolated per conversation; also exposes the tab-registration service other plugins use.

notes.zh: 安装体积最大（约 12 MB 客户端产物）。dsh-remote 装在一起时会把远程资源管理器与终端注册进来。
notes.en: Largest client artifact (~12 MB). With dsh-remote installed it receives the remote explorer and terminal tabs.

summary.zh: SSH 远程工作区：远程终端、文件浏览与搜索、Git diff、X11 转发、macOS 主机支持，并提供远端改码/构建/测试的 Agent 工具。
summary.en: SSH remote workspaces: remote terminals, file browsing and search, Git diffs, X11 forwarding, macOS hosts, and workspace-bound Agent tools.

recommendsWhy.better-sidebar: 远程资源管理器、远程文件与终端会注册进右侧栏；没有右侧栏时只能用 DSH 原生侧栏。

external.name: ssh-hosts
external.zh: 至少一台可通过 SSH 连上的远程主机（密码或密钥，X11 转发还需要远端装好 X 客户端并设置 DISPLAY）。
external.en: At least one SSH-reachable host (password or key; X11 forwarding also needs an X client and DISPLAY on the remote side).

notes.zh: 推荐与「右侧栏」一起安装：远程资源管理器、文件与终端会注册进右侧栏；只装 remote 也能用 DSH 原生侧栏。本地 UI 定制：远程目录选择器改为顶部服务器列表 + 下方可展开目录树（上一级 / 主目录 / 刷新），本机按钮文案为「浏览文件夹」。
notes.en: Recommended together with Better sidebar: the remote explorer, files and terminals register into it. Without it, the native DSH sidebar still works. Local UI: the remote directory picker is a server list plus an expandable folder tree (Up / Home / Refresh), and the local button reads "Browse folder".

summary.zh: 输入框下方的下班倒计时胶囊，到点后转成加班计时；到点由 Host 先闪烁任务栏，回到前台再播放可定制烟花（9 种样式 + 范围/密度/时长，设置里可预览）。
summary.en: A countdown pill under the composer that turns into an overtime timer after the end time; the Host flashes the taskbar at the end time and the configurable fireworks (9 styles plus scope/density/duration) play once the window is in the foreground.

notes.zh: 无依赖，可单独安装。设置保存在 $DSH_HOME/offwork-countdown/settings.json（升级/重启不重置）；到点由 Host 侧定时闪任务栏，页面在后台被节流也不会漏；上下班时间用自绘两列选择器（不循环、点分钟即收起）。
notes.en: No dependencies; safe to install alone. Settings live in $DSH_HOME/offwork-countdown/settings.json (survive updates/restarts); the Host schedules the taskbar flash, so background tab throttling cannot skip it; time fields use a custom two-column picker (no wrap, closes on minute pick).

summary.zh: dock 里的 CPU／内存／显卡／显存进度条；在 DSH Host 进程采样，因此显示的始终是会话真正所在的那台主机。
summary.en: CPU, memory, GPU and VRAM bars in the dock, sampled in the DSH Host process so they describe the machine the session actually lives on.

recommendsWhy.remote: 要监控远程工作区所在主机，需要 dsh-remote 提供的远程会话；只装本模块只看本机。

notes.zh: 看本机时无需任何依赖；要监控远程工作区所在主机，需要同时装「远程工作区」。
notes.en: Works standalone for the local machine; monitoring a remote workspace's host needs Remote workspaces installed.

summary.zh: 跨会话待办清单（可注册到侧栏）：Agent 报「完成」只进待确认、人点头才算数；支持步骤计划、文档与地址、交给会话继续做、多机同步。
summary.en: Cross-session todo list (sidebar panel available): an agent's done only reaches Needs review until a person confirms; steps, links, hand-off to a conversation, multi-machine sync.

notes.zh: 无依赖。清单默认存 $DSH_HOME/global-todo/todos.json。本地改动：展开会话待办不再因 ctx 未定义崩溃；「交给」默认当前会话（也可注册进 better-sidebar 的 tab），添加待办不绑定工作区/会话。 待办状态底色跟随 color-style 的会话状态配色（进行中为流光带），进行中时菜单显示「标为未开始」。
notes.en: No dependencies; the list lives in $DSH_HOME/global-todo/todos.json by default. Local changes: the detail/jump button no longer crashes; hand-off defaults to the current conversation (also registered as a better-sidebar tab); adding a todo binds neither a workspace nor a session. Todo surface tints follow color-style session-status colors (in-progress uses the sweep), and the menu offers "mark not started" while in progress.

summary.zh: 把微信／飞书／企业微信／钉钉／QQ／Telegram／WhatsApp／Slack／Discord／Matrix 接入 DSH。
summary.en: Connect WeChat, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord and Matrix to DSH.

external.name: im-platforms
external.zh: 每个要用到平台自己的机器人凭据（token／应用 ID 与密钥／扫码登录），以及能访问该平台服务器的网络。
external.en: Bot credentials for each platform you actually use (tokens, app id/secret, QR login) and network access to those platforms.

notes.zh: 体积最大的模块（约 22 MB 代码 + 40 MB 运行时依赖）；不用 IM 就别装。配置与凭据存 $DSH_HOME/im。
notes.en: The heaviest module (~22 MB code + 40 MB runtime dependencies); skip it if you do not use IM. Settings and credentials live in $DSH_HOME/im.

summary.zh: 本机任意根会话完成一轮时，把会话名、用户输入和最终助手正文（markdown）推送到飞书；卡片 2.0 渲染标题、列表与表格。凭据复用 dsh-im 里已配置的飞书机器人。
summary.en: On every root Session turn completion on this machine, push the session name, the user prompt and the final assistant markdown to Feishu as a card-2.0 markdown bubble (headings, lists, tables) through the dsh-im Feishu bot.

external.name: feishu-bot
external.zh: 需要在 dsh-im 里配置并启用一个飞书机器人；没有机器人时会跳过推送。
external.en: A Feishu bot must be configured and activated in dsh-im; without one the push is skipped.

external.name: feishu-receiver
external.zh: 默认推送给机器人 owner 的 open_id；要发到群里请把 receiveIdType/receiveId 配成 chat_id。
external.en: By default it pushes to the bot owner open_id; set receiveIdType/receiveId to a chat_id for a group.

notes.zh: 依赖 IM 模块（dsh-im）与其飞书机器人；不装 IM 时静默跳过。卡片 2.0 markdown 渲染表格；单组件最多 4 张表，超出自动分块；旧客户端自动退回 lark_md。推送串行排队，正文超 8000 字截断。
notes.en: Depends on the dsh-im module and its Feishu bot; without IM it silently skips. Card-2.0 markdown renders tables; a component holds at most 4 tables, extra tables are split into more components; old clients fall back to lark_md. Pushes are queued serially; bodies over 8000 chars are truncated.

summary.zh: 导入 ComfyUI 工作流、卡片式调参、跑图/跑视频，并归档每次运行的参数与种子。
summary.en: Import ComfyUI workflows, tune them as cards, run image/video jobs, and archive each run's parameters and seed.

external.name: comfyui-server
external.zh: 一个可访问的 ComfyUI 服务（默认 http://127.0.0.1:8188）；没有它面板能打开但跑不了任务。
external.en: A reachable ComfyUI server (default http://127.0.0.1:8188); without it the panel opens but runs fail.

notes.zh: 插件本身很轻；真正的成本是外部 ComfyUI 服务与模型文件。
notes.en: The plugin is light; the real cost is the external ComfyUI server and its models.
